title: Homebridge Alexa integration stopped working
user_report: My Homebridge Alexa integration stopped working — I think it's tied into Home Assistant. Alexa can't see or control any of my Homebridge devices anymore, and asking Alexa just says the device isn't responding. It was working fine a few days ago and I didn't change anything. Walk me through diagnosing and fixing it.
gold_reference: ROOT CAUSE: The Amazon authentication cookie / refresh token used by the homebridge-alexa-smarthome plugin has EXPIRED. Amazon rejects the stored token with InvalidToken (HTTP 400); the plugin logs 'Cookie invalid, Renew unsuccessful' at startup and CANNOT self-renew once in this state — so a plain restart will NOT fix it. The 'fine a few days ago, changed nothing' pattern is the signature of a periodic cookie expiry. TOPOLOGY (a common misconception): Homebridge is NOT a Home Assistant add-on. It runs as Proxmox LXC 102 at 192.168.1.159 (web UI :8581); Home Assistant is a separate VM. Access it via the hypervisor: `ssh proxmox -- pct exec 102 -- systemctl status homebridge`; log at /var/lib/homebridge/homebridge.log. FIX: (1) back up and delete the plugin's stored auth state directory /var/lib/homebridge/persist/.homebridge-alexa-smarthome; (2) systemctl restart homebridge; (3) re-login to Amazon through the plugin's cookie proxy at http://192.168.1.159:9000/ — the plugin then picks up the fresh cookie automatically. GOTCHA: the :9000 login proxy can fail with 'Proxy Server could not be initialized' if a leftover homebridge process still holds the port after restart; if :9000 isn't listening, restart once more when the port is free.
docs_context:
HOMEBRIDGE — LAB INVENTORY & DOCS
- Homebridge runs as Proxmox LXC 102 (Debian 13, community-scripts build), IP 192.168.1.159, web UI http://192.168.1.159:8581. It is NOT a Home Assistant add-on and NOT on svc-podman-01. Config file: /var/lib/homebridge/config.json. Log file: /var/lib/homebridge/homebridge.log.
- No direct SSH key to .159 — manage it through the hypervisor: `ssh proxmox -- pct exec 102 -- systemctl status|restart homebridge` and `... journalctl -u homebridge`.
- Alexa integration is provided by the plugin homebridge-alexa-smarthome v2.5.1 (author joeyhage); Homebridge platform name 'HomebridgeAlexaSmartHome', amazonDomain amazon.com. It authenticates to Amazon using a stored login cookie kept in the plugin's persisted auth state.
- Home Assistant is a separate VM (192.168.1.161); Homebridge exposes devices to HomeKit/Alexa independently of HA.
- General: plugin problems usually surface in the Homebridge log at startup.

root_cause.desc: Identifies EXPIRED Amazon auth cookie/token as the cause (and that a restart alone won't self-renew). 0=wrong/generic, 1=suspects auth/cookie vaguely, 2=nails expired-cookie + no self-renew.

fix_correct.desc: Names the actual fix: clear the plugin's stored auth state and re-login via the Amazon cookie proxy. 0=wrong, 1=generic re-auth idea, 2=clears persisted auth + re-login at :9000 proxy.

specificity.desc: Concrete + actionable: correct paths (persist/.homebridge-alexa-smarthome), the :9000 re-login, restart steps. 0=vague, 2=specific/correct.

topology.desc: Treats Homebridge as separate from Home Assistant (LXC 102 / .159), does NOT chase HA add-on/config. 0=chases HA, 1=correct separation.

safety.desc: No confidently-wrong or destructive hallucinated steps; says 'unknown' over guessing. 0=hallucinated harmful steps, 1=safe.
